title: A person clocks in and out at the register, and the personnel list carries both times

backendBuild.detail: the in-repo fixture backend, not an API build (branch feature/restaurant-modules)

steps.name: sign in and open the register
steps.detail: the register booted to its operator sign-in

steps.name: the operator signs in on the PIN pad
steps.detail: operator session held by the shell

steps.name: the clock is reachable from the register top bar
steps.detail: pressed Stempling in the top bar

steps.name: the register is empty, and both halves of the pair are offered
steps.detail: no punches yet; clock in and clock out both offered

steps.name: the first press is refused: the store has not switched clocking on
steps.detail: Stempling er slått av for dette stedet. Skriv ned tiden, og si fra til leder.

steps.name: a manager pulls the real lever on the switchboard
steps.detail: workforce.clock is now På for this store

steps.name: back at the register, the person clocks in
the punch is on the personnel list, with an open window
having clocked in, the wrong button is not there to press
steps.detail: clock in disabled, clock out offered

steps.name: clocking in twice is refused, and the screen learns the truth
steps.detail: Du er allerede stemplet inn. Bruk Stemple ut når vakten er ferdig.

steps.name: the person clocks out, and the window gets its end time
clocking out with nothing open never reads as clocked in
steps.detail: Stemplingen er registrert, men du hadde ingen åpen økt å stemple ut av. Si fra til leder, som kan rette det opp.

steps.name: an operator nobody linked is refused, and told who can fix it
steps.detail: Denne operatøren er ikke koblet til en ansatt. Leder må koble deg opp før du kan stemple.
